subject.title: feat: carry Featured state into Control

question: Should a successful trusted ClawHub feed or snapshot—including omission of `featured`—override bundled Featured metadata for uniquely package/source-matched published plugins?
rationale: The code can enforce either policy safely, but choosing hosted curation over shipped bundled metadata is a product authority and rollout decision rather than a correctness question CI can settle.

options.title: Approve hosted authority
options.body: Treat trusted hosted curation as authoritative for provenance-matched published plugins while retaining bundled authority for private entries and offline fallback.

options.title: Require explicit booleans
options.body: Preserve bundled Featured state when the hosted field is absent and require the producer to send `featured: false` for explicit unfeaturing.

recommendation.title: Approve hosted authority
recommendation.body: Treat trusted hosted curation as authoritative for provenance-matched published plugins while retaining bundled authority for private entries and offline fallback.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Control plugin-discovery and official-catalog ownership is the closest available history signal for this authority decision.
